================================================================================
USER PERSONA ANALYSIS
================================================================================

ARTIST:
+ Can: View profile, get booked, receive requests in DB
- Cannot: See booking requests, respond, manage gigs
! Blocker: No dashboard

PROMOTER:
+ Can: View profile, show events, sell club membership
- Cannot: Create events, book artists, sell tickets
! Blocker: No event management

VENUE:
+ Can: View profile, sell club membership
- Cannot: List venue, manage events, sell tickets
! Blocker: No venue dashboard

FAN:
+ Can: Browse events, join clubs (once SQL runs), book artist requests
- Cannot: Buy tickets, get reminders, see friends attending
! Blocker: Ticket checkout incomplete

PHASE 1 - MONETIZATION CORE (Current - 1 sprint)
================================================
GRID-001: Run SQL migrations in Supabase [P0] [5min]
GRID-002: Test Join Club end-to-end [P0] [30min]
GRID-003: Install stripe package + env vars [P0] [15min]
GRID-004: Build /api/webhooks/stripe handler [P0] [2h]

THE ONE THING TO DO RIGHT NOW
================================================================================

Run the SQL migrations in Supabase.

$sql1 = Get-Content supabase/migrations/20261022_unified_clubs.sql -Raw
$sql2 = Get-Content supabase/migrations/20261022_stripe_memberships.sql -Raw
Set-Clipboard -Value ($sql1 + sql2)

Then paste in Supabase SQL Editor and click Run.

Once done, test the Join flow. You are then 100% done with Phase 1's frontend.
Only Stripe integration remains (2 days).

That is the map. You are at 80% of Phase 1 out of 5 total phases.
Every phase makes the app more valuable and closer to full launch.
